verdict.rationale: Viam is a robotics and machine-management platform that agents operate (via CLI and SDKs), not an AI agent or LLM client that consumes external tools, so plugging in MCP servers as a tool client is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Viam acting as an MCP client, which would have made the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
